title: Single Command execute ON request
purpose: Cover a canonical control ASDU with unambiguous supplied qualifier semantics for execute plus ON state.
expected_behavior: Parser accepts a valid TypeID 45 single command request and dispatches to the single-command handler with SCO execute/ON semantics.
constraints_preserved: TypeID 45 matches supplied mapping for C_SC_NA_1
ASDU keeps common address and 3-byte IOA ordering typical for 104
Qualifier byte uses select/execute bit 0 and command state ON per supplied common command qualifier table
APCI length 0x0e matches four control bytes plus ten ASDU bytes
issue_safety_notes: Valid command-path seed only; avoids unsupported timed variant encodings and any malformed qualifier experimentation.
